record.paper_title: Some Open Problems Related to Creative Telescoping
record.context_brief: Recurrences for diagonals of rational series
record.original_question: For each d in {4, 5, ..., 12}, prove recurrence equations for the diagonal coefficient sequence of the rational series 1 / (1 − Σ_{i=1}^d x_i/(1 − x_i)). Here the diagonal means the univariate series obtained by taking coefficients a_{n,n,...,n} from the underlying d-variate power series.

evidence.quote: Problem 9.1 For d = 4, 5, ··· , 12, prove recurrence equations for the diagonals of the rational series 1/(1 − ∑_{i=1}^d x_i/(1−x_i)) conjectured in [104].

artifact.self_contained_problem:
For an integer $d\geq 1$, consider the $d$-variate rational power series
$$F_d(x_1,\dots,x_d)\;=\;\frac{1}{1-\displaystyle\sum_{i=1}^d \frac{x_i}{1-x_i}}\;=\;\sum_{n_1,\dots,n_d\geq 0} c_{n_1,\dots,n_d}\, x_1^{n_1}\cdots x_d^{n_d}\;\in\;\mathbb{Q}[\![x_1,\dots,x_d]\!].$$
Define the diagonal of $F_d$ to be the univariate sequence $(a_n)_{n\geq 0}$ with $a_n = c_{n,n,\dots,n}$, and let $D_d(t)=\sum_{n\geq 0} a_n t^n$ be its generating function. It is known that $D_d(t)$ is D-finite, so $(a_n)$ satisfies some linear recurrence with polynomial coefficients in $n$.

Problem. For each $d \in \{4,5,6,7,8,9,10,11,12\}$, prove (rigorously establish) an explicit linear recurrence equation with polynomial coefficients satisfied by the diagonal sequence $(a_n)_{n\geq 0}$ of $F_d$.
artifact.category_tag: Diagonals of rational functions / creative telescoping
artifact.status_search_result: A targeted web search did not surface a published proof establishing the conjectured recurrences for the diagonals of $1/(1-\sum_{i=1}^d x_i/(1-x_i))$ for the range $d\in\{4,\dots,12\}$. The problem is listed as an open problem in the literature on creative telescoping; while related work (e.g. on telescopers of rational functions and the Griffiths–Dwork method) has advanced the underlying algorithms, no specific evidence of a complete proof of all cases up to $d=12$ was found.

status_evidence.title: Plea for Diagonals and Telescopers of Rational Functions
status_evidence.snippet: Diagonals of multivariate power series form an important class occurring frequently in number theory, theoretical physics and enumerative combinatorics; recurrences are sought via creative telescoping.
status_evidence.claim: Computing/proving recurrences for diagonals of rational functions remains an active area, with cases of growing dimension being pursued by creative telescoping.

status_evidence.title: Efficient rational creative telescoping
status_evidence.snippet: Algorithmic improvements for telescopers of rational functions.
status_evidence.claim: Ongoing algorithmic development indicates higher-dimensional diagonal recurrences are not yet routinely certified.
